verdict.rationale: Codex produces AI-generated insights from the user's own code. Its dedicated review mode "reports prioritized findings" on changes, and it can explore unfamiliar code and plan changes, with summaries shown inside the product. Plugins can connect it to a team's tools and data, but there is no documented insight or suggestion feature for non-code data. missing for 10: insights over non-code business data, documentation of how suggestions are surfaced beyond code review and summaries, independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Codex reports prioritized findings without modifying your working tree, so you can address risks before you commit or open a pull request.
Start Codex in a repository to explore unfamiliar code, plan a change, edit files, and run your local development tools.
Inspect the summary and diff, request a follow-up, or open a pull request when the result is ready.
add plugins to connect Codex to your team's tools and data without leaving the CLI.
